description:
Answer before glasses work starts:
- Does the G2 firmware font render hiragana, katakana, and common kanji in text containers and list/menu items (textContainerUpgrade, menu itemName)? Any tofu, width, or line-wrapping problems? If not, what fallback (romaji? English on glasses only?) is acceptable.
- Real byte/character limits for menu labels and text bodies with 3-byte UTF-8 characters; does truncateUtf8 ever split a grapheme visibly?
- What locale the Even Realities host WebView reports (navigator.language/languages) on Android and iOS when the phone and the Even app are set to Japanese; does the Even Hub SDK expose the host app language?
- Semantics of app.json "supported_languages" for Even Hub review/listing, and whether permission descriptions or store text can be localized.
Record results in docs/phase0/RUNBOOK.md (or a new note) and comment findings here.

comments.text: Desk findings in docs/i18n.md: SDK exposes no locale (UserInfo has country only) so navigator.languages drives 'system'; menu itemName is validated at 32 UTF-8 bytes (10 kana/kanji); evenhub-cli accepts ja in supported_languages; permission desc can't be localized. G2 firmware glyph coverage for kana/kanji needs a device: moved to irl-subt-0n7.10.

title: Spike: Japanese text on the G2 display and host locale detection in the Even Hub WebView
